feedback: The confession follows the most relevant pre-vote contradiction: his own query establishes knowledge he later denies. The admission that he took poison during the preview and put it in the glass supplies the actual action, which was inferable but not observed; it does not introduce a new technical mechanism or hidden source. Chip and Elle admit the exact alternative deceptions their records suggested, so the ordering resolves the competing explanations fairly after the vote. The final remarks to Dada and Reed connect his shame to relationships rather than merely reciting laboratory facts. It feels earned as a plausible solution and emotionally coherent, though the pre-vote case still supported uncertainty about which concealment masked murder.
